lanes.title: Make browserRecovery.test.ts robust under hosted load on the recovered-release integration branch
lanes.description: Linear OVD-636 (child of OVD-633). worker/src/recovery/browserRecovery.test.ts exists ONLY on the integration branch codex/recovered-release-free-safety-20261003 (PR #564). Hosted failures under full-suite load: 'applies only the declared value and stops after two actions' timed out at 5000 ms; 'selects an existing option without sending option values' expected true, received false; earlier PR bodies (#568, #571, #592) record the same file timing out at 5 s / 30 s. Unverified analysis to confirm by reproduction: the 'bounded recovery with observed Chromium DOM' tests use the default 5 s per-test timeout while each runs real-Chromium recovery attempts; worker/src/recovery/browserRecovery.ts enforces a production 5 s attempt deadline and 1 s fill/select/inputValue timeouts, so under load the attempt is cancelled by its own deadline and returns false. Fix the TESTS (and, only if required, add an injectable clock/deadline seam to browserRecovery.ts that defaults to the production values and is covered by a test that the defaults are unchanged) so that they await observable state instead of fixed timers, raise per-test timeouts only on the real-browser paths, and serialize the real-browser files if they contend for the runner. The OVD-633 main-side sibling PR #599 (worker/src/adapters/xometry.test.ts, deferred-based sequencing; red-first with a SIGSTOP stall harness) is the pattern to copy for evidence. Never skip, quarantine, or weaken the DOM-redaction and bounded-action assertions; never raise the production deadline.
files: worker/src/recovery/browserRecovery.ts (only for an injectable deadline/clock seam with unchanged defaults)
<worker vitest config only if serialization is needed>
lanes.guidance: Base is the #564 integration branch: fetch origin/codex/recovered-release-free-safety-20261003 first; lockfile family #564 (/home/user/wt/base564 symlinks; see ENV.md). chromiumSandbox is true in this file: run the test as the non-root user ubuntu per ENV.md (runuser -u ubuntu -- env HOME=/tmp/ubuntu-home PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers ...); never disable the sandbox. Red first: reproduce at least one failure under load with the SIGSTOP/SIGCONT stall harness the #599 implementer used (its stallrun.sh/inject.sh idea: freeze the vitest process group for 150-300 ms every 350-500 ms) or an injected event-loop stall; record command and output. Green: 20 consecutive passes under the same load; a mutation that reintroduces the fixed timer or drops the awaited state check fails again. Empty-diff CI re-triggers are not allowed; one PR run plus the single re-run allowance. Root cause in the PR body. Open a DRAFT PR with base codex/recovered-release-free-safety-20261003, title starting 'OVD-636: ', body per the template, stating that merge goes into the integration branch and that the production apply is protected. Never write the release-parent identifiers listed in ENV.md; never put a Linear closing word before an issue id in the PR body.
lanes.failure_first: Under the stall harness the 5 s per-test timeout or the deadline-driven false result reproduces on the unmodified test (captured output). After the change 20/20 runs pass under the same load; mutations: reintroduce the fixed timer -> fails; drop the awaited state check -> fails; (if a seam is added) change a production default -> the defaults test fails.
lanes.verification: runuser -u ubuntu -- ... npx vitest run worker/src/recovery/browserRecovery.test.ts (20 iterations under the stall harness); npm --prefix worker run verify (as ubuntu where Chromium is launched); npm run lint && npm run typecheck. Hosted (result of record): test, verify-worker at the PR head.
